verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a public roadmap and webhooks that fire on status changes. Neither is a documented PM view for watching the real-time status of each in-progress task, what it is blocked on, or its last update. The webhooks are developer building blocks and the roadmap is an adjacent feature, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can watch the real-time status of each in-progress task, including what it's blocked on and its last update
